description: This file defines the 'I18NLanguage' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, modeling a language used for internationalization (i18n). It includes properties like id, name, code, enabled status, added status, and modification timestamp, with ORM mappings and accessor methods.

classes.name: I18NLanguage
classes.description: Entity class representing an internationalization language, with properties for id, name, code, enabled, added, and modifiedAt, along with getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the language.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the language.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the language.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the language.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the language is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether the language is enabled.

methods.name: isAdded
methods.description: Returns whether the language has been added.

methods.name: setAdded
methods.description: Sets whether the language has been added.
